note: The logo is served from cdn.bloomflowers.example — the site's own CDN subdomain, which is the single most reasonable-looking thing in this whole corpus. ADR-004 makes it a DIFFERENT ORIGIN and therefore cross-origin, because a subdomain is frequently delegated to a third party and inheriting the parent's branding would let that party impersonate it. This fixture exists because it is the one a future contributor is most likely to 'fix' into a bug: the failing test looks like over-strictness until you know why. The logo drops to a monogram; the rest of the branding survives, so a bad asset never costs a site its whole integration.
